claim: EGM separates context-rich design drafting from fresh-context document review; small clear bug fixes are explicitly routed to normal coding workflows.
Five ordered review stages: zoom out, comprehension, critique, second zoom out, implementation readiness. Uninterrupted mode uses nine reviewer invocations.
Goldfish must use native fresh contexts; fork_turns none is explicitly supported. Fresh context does not isolate filesystem, configured memory, or project instructions.
Reviewer must first paraphrase both the proposed change and the documented existing system; inability to paraphrase is a blocker.
Implementation plans require predetermined architectural decisions, explicit files, precise steps, and concrete tests; this is a document standard, not behavioral proof.
Failed reviewers retry once then remain not run; clean excludes missing reviewers. Convergence requires two clean rounds with a five-round cap; contested and accepted-risk findings can be settled.
Bottom-up component contracts and parent blueprints can use EGM.md to preserve existing README files; scope-dependent parallelism and full-tree discovery can be expensive.
Drift is an agent reading and comparing documents and source; no deterministic equivalence proof or scheduler is supplied by this skill.

Repository reports Codex fixture execution and native isolation evidence, but ChatGPT Work has open trace/final audit gaps. Native live tests consume host quota. These results were not independently rerun here.

Live tests use isolated temporary plugin installs, native launch/read/completion traces, and require at least 15 child reviewers. The fixture preapproves interactions and writes no implementation code.
Offline unit suite runs on Ubuntu and Windows with pinned action SHAs and Python test dependencies; this suite cannot establish semantic review quality.
Runtime is skills, instructions, and local documentation workflows; no hosted service, database or telemetry endpoint. Host policies govern processing and retention.
Apache 2.0 and explicitly not an officially supported Google product. Google-engineer usage claim is a repository claim, not independently verified.
Living checked-in specifications link ideation to implementation and drift checking; named orchestration is host-executed agent instruction, not evidence of a durable factory scheduler.
